messages.subject: Re: [poppr] Error making a dendogram from a distance matrix using the function (bruvo_boot)
messages.subject_clean: [poppr] Error making a dendogram from a distance matrix using the function (bruvo_boot)
messages.body_plain:
Hi,

Here's what I assume: you got this by using either aboot() or bruvo.boot() with the default arguments.

If the above is true, then the reason you got this message is because you have missing data in your distance matrix from one of the bootstrap replicates (there may be individuals in your data set that have a lot of missing data).

My suggestion is to change the tree argument to ape::njs

Hope that helps,
Zhian

messages.subject: Re: [poppr] Error in poppr
messages.body_plain:
Hi,

It's difficult to address this issue since I don't know what version of R or RStudio you are using or what platform you are running (it's also is not a poppr-specific issue). My generic advice for this is to search for any hidden files called ".RData" in your working folder and delete them. After you do that, restart R. In RStudio, go to Tools > Global Options > General and uncheck the box that says "Restore .RData into workspace on startup" and select "Never" under "Save workspace to .RData on exit"

Best,
Zhian
